channel.title: Prepared Foods Magazine - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Prepared Foods Magazine (preparedfoods.com)

item.title: Rise Baking Company Names Mark McNeil CEO
item.description: Rise Baking Company appointed Mark McNeil as chief executive officer, succeeding Brian Zellmer after five years of transformational growth. McNeil brings more than 30 years of leadership experience across retail, foodservice and manufacturing, most recently serving as CEO of Shearer’s Foods.

item.title: De La Calle Debuts Strawberry Citrus Soda
item.description: De La Calle kicked off the new year with the launch of Strawberry Citrus, a new fermented soda blending strawberries and citrus for a crisp, refreshing profile. The debut coincides with the brand’s new Frutas campaign, reinforcing its focus on fruit-forward flavor and modern interpretations of Mexican soda culture.

item.title: ADM: Ready to Reformulate?
item.description: Leveraging its wide-ranging portfolio of ingredients derived from natural sources paired with science-backed health and wellness solutions, ADM will highlight how brands can effectively reformulate to fulfill the needs of consumers today.

item.title: Magtein: Better Brain Health
item.description: Reported results included improvements in overall cognitive performance, working and episodic memory, faster reaction time, improved PROMIS sleep-related impairment, a 7.5-year reduction in estimated brain cognitive age, and favorable changes in physiological stress markers (reduced resting heart rate and increased heart rate variability).

item.title: Creations Foods, REAL Cookies Complete Merger
item.description: Creations Foods USA Inc. and Get Real Foods LLC, dba REAL Cookies, completed a strategic merger to form a vertically integrated CPG platform dedicated to healthier snacking across North America. The combination brings together scalable manufacturing capabilities with award-winning cookie brands built around simple ingredients and indulgent taste.

item.title: Little Debbie Rolls Out Ice Cream Sandwiches
item.description: Little Debbie is expanding its frozen dessert lineup with the national rollout of Little Debbie Ice Cream Sandwiches. Available in Oatmeal Creme Pies and Cosmic Brownies varieties, the sandwiches extend the brand’s snack cake flavors into a handheld ice cream format.

item.title: Next-Gen Ingredients Redefine Plant-Based Foods
item.description: Plant-based foods have moved far beyond soy and pea, with novel proteins, fats, and processing technologies driving unprecedented gains in flavor, texture, and functionality. As innovation accelerates, formulators now have the tools to create both convincing animal analogs and compelling plant-forward alternatives.

item.title: Coloring Between the Lines: Dairy
item.description: As new federal rules push food and beverage makers away from artificial dyes, dairy developers are facing one of the toughest reformulation challenges yet.

item.title: RäFoods Names Des Hague CEO, President
item.description: RäFoods appointed Des Hague chief executive officer and president as the food technology company accelerates its focus on functional nutrition. Hague brings decades of experience scaling global consumer brands and will lead efforts to expand innovation across retail and foodservice channels.

item.title: Royal Cup Expands RTD Cold Brew Line
item.description: Royal Cup Coffee and Tea expanded its ready-to-drink cold brew portfolio with four new varieties, including Black Cold Brew and three latte options. The launch responds to continued growth in cold brew consumption and broadens the line to offer both coffee-forward and indulgent flavor profiles.
